findings.issue: The signed digest stays a hash of memory ranges (sha3(report) and the 128-byte encoding with reportContext = calldata[4 len 96] are not combined into sha3(sha3(report), ...)), and one storage struct s_signers[signer] is printed three ways in four lines: stor9[concat(mem[0])], stor[_274] and stor[_274].field_8.
findings.rule: Same free-pointer root cause as P2 for the digest. For mappings: once _274 = keccak(key . 9) is recognised as the slot of stor9[key], print every access through _274 as stor9[key].field_n, and print the key as the address written to mem[0] rather than concat(mem[0]).

notes: Most of the registry's functions live in KeeperRegistryLogicA/B reached through the fallback's delegatecall; this contract's own code is transmit, setConfig, the views and the payment helpers. OVM_GasPriceOracle.getL1GasUsed's loop is in the Optimism predeploy (external call), not counted. Loop map: getActiveUpkeepIDs (457), setConfig's three loops (898 old transmitters, 933 old signers, 970 new signers/transmitters with the duplicate checks), transmit's three report loops (1398, 1584, 1671) and _verifyReportSignature's rs loop (1538: rawVs bound 32, uint8 + 27 overflow check, ecrecover, OnlyActiveSigners, signedCount += shift(1, 8 * uint5(index)) — the uint5 is exact, 8 * index is an unchecked uint8 product — and DuplicateSigners after the loop), all checked against the source. Implicit: calldata decode loops, memory-to-storage copies of signers/transmitters, ABI encode loops of the ConfigSet event and config digest (P7), getState's storage-to-memory copies rotated (P3, 2) and transmit's struct-array zero-init rotated (P3, 1).
summary: Faithful, with all source loops as readable whiles and the signature-verification logic exact; minor issues are unresolved digests and inconsistent naming of one storage struct.
